observed_rational_size.scope: Observed stored inputs/projectors/constructed updates in seeded cases only, not all intermediate bigint/gcd memory

exact_algebra.scope: Finite exact-rational verification; unrestricted algebraic proofs are separate, no stored/BIT authorization

proved_cardinality_bounds.scope: Bounds follow from finite encoding and an injective free-coordinate projection of the affine ALG solution set; they are not exhaustive format searches.

families.domain_scope: All fixed-registry protected inputs; candidate alphabet/mask is separately finite

executable_capacity_semantics.counted_set: E_cert: endpoints accepted by the unchanged A3 complete-registry checker
executable_capacity_semantics.BIT_alias: The BIT fields report E_cert membership and counts.
executable_capacity_semantics.agreement_condition: For these supported fixed registries, valid initial banks, canonical finite candidate words, available correct arithmetic, and fixed version/policy, the checker exhausts every local call and invariant case. Its accepted set therefore agrees with the finite local BIT relation under the declared baseline invariant. Independent direct evaluation checks the enumerated instances.
executable_capacity_semantics.excluded: No equality claim for arbitrary unsupported proof routes, domains, failure semantics, compilers or backends.
